Like, I'll promise a tenant I'm coming right back with a new air filter or a wrench, and then I just completely forget the basic follow-ups I promised people. It's just piled up so much lately. Dave actually sent me here because there's a lead tech spot opening up, and he said I'm gonna lose my shot at moving up if I don't get this sorted out.

I actually tried buying one of those anti-glare screen protectors online, but when I put it on, it got all these little dust bubbles trapped underneath. It drove me absolutely crazy. My niece usually puts those on for me because she has such a steady hand. She just went off to college for graphic design, actually, which is great, she's so artistic and I'm really proud of her... but yeah, without her around I just completely messed up the screen protector. 

Wait, what was I talking about? Oh, right. The new management. Yeah, since they switched us to the digital system and started demanding all this strict documentation 11 months ago, it's just been so much worse. I can't keep track of it all.
